tasks.subject: Task 1: ROM loading and patch enumeration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A library that enumerates every patch (internal + expansion) with correct names and counts.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/jv_rom.h`, `src/jv_rom.cpp`
- Create: `tests/test_jv_rom.cpp`
- Create: `CMakeLists.txt`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- 192 internal patches; index 0 `A.Piano 1`, 64 `Pizzicato`, 128 `JV Strings`
- 20 usable boards totalling 4005 patches
- SR-JV80-01 has 145 patches, patch 0 `770 Grand 1`
- Boards 97/98 reported unusable, not crashed on

**Verify:** `cmake --build build --target test_jv_rom && ./build/test_jv_rom`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/jv_rom.h", "src/jv_rom.cpp", "tests/test_jv_rom.cpp", "CMakeLists.txt"], "verifyCommand": "cmake --build build --target test_jv_rom && ./build/test_jv_rom", "acceptanceCriteria": ["192 internal patches with correct names", "20 usable boards totalling 4005 patches", "board 01 has 145 patches", "boards 97/98 unusable without crashing"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Patch preprocessing and LFO strip decision
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Read effect and LFO parameters, decide LFO strippability, produce dry render bytes.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/jv_patch.h`, `src/jv_patch.cpp`
- Create: `tests/test_jv_patch.cpp`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Effects decode from byte 12 bits 0-3 (reverbtype) / 4-5 (chorustype), byte 16 bit 7 (chorusoutput)
- Tone LFO read from tone bytes 23-36; tone level at 67 gates active
- Strip only when active tones agree (waveform identical, rate +/-4, depths +/-6 same sign, sync identical) and form is not RND1/RND2
- preprocess zeroes reverblevel 13, choruslevel 16 low bits, portamento byte 24 bit 6, and stripped LFO depths

**Verify:** `cmake --build build --target test_jv_patch && ./build/test_jv_patch`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/jv_patch.h", "src/jv_patch.cpp", "tests/test_jv_patch.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "cmake --build build --target test_jv_patch && ./build/test_jv_patch", "acceptanceCriteria": ["effect params decode from correct bitfields", "tone LFO params from tone bytes 23-36", "inactive tones excluded", "RND and divergent tones block stripping", "preprocess mutations correct and bounded"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Deterministic grid renderer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Render one patch's 25 x 3 grid to raw WAV plus metadata JSON, deterministically.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/wav.h`, `src/wav.cpp`, `src/jv_render.h`, `src/jv_render.cpp`, `src/jv_sampler.cpp`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- 75 stereo 16-bit 64000 Hz cells per patch
- Byte-identical across two runs
- Dry tail under 5% of peak
- patch.json records effects and both LFO decisions

**Verify:** `./build/jv_sampler --roms "$ROMS" --board "JV-880 Internal" --patch 0 --out /tmp/jvtest && ls /tmp/jvtest/*/*.wav | wc -l`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/wav.h", "src/wav.cpp", "src/jv_render.h", "src/jv_render.cpp", "src/jv_sampler.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "./build/jv_sampler --roms \"$ROMS\" --board \"JV-880 Internal\" --patch 0 --out /tmp/jvtest && ls /tmp/jvtest/*/*.wav | wc -l", "acceptanceCriteria": ["75 WAV cells per patch", "byte-identical across runs", "dry tail under 5% of peak", "patch.json has effects and LFO decisions"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Effect calibration by measurement
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Measure emulator chorus/reverb response into calibration.json.

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/calibrate.cpp`, `tools/analyze_calibration.py`, `tests/test_calibration.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Sweeps chorusrate/depth/level and reverbtime per type 0-5 and reverblevel
- Chorus rate monotonic, spans at least 2x
- RT60 monotonic per type
- calibration.json has chorus_rate_hz, chorus_depth_norm, chorus_mix, reverb_rt60, reverb_wet

**Verify:** `python3 -m pytest tests/test_calibration.py -v`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/calibrate.cpp", "tools/analyze_calibration.py", "tests/test_calibration.py"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -m pytest tests/test_calibration.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["five tables present", "chorus rate monotonic and spans 2x", "RT60 monotonic per type", "reverb wet increases"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Post-processing, loops, release, FLAC
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Convert 64 kHz WAV to 48 kHz 24-bit FLAC with loops and release times.

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/postprocess.py`, `tests/test_postprocess.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- FLAC 48000 Hz 24-bit stereo
- Steady sine loops with endpoints within 1% of peak; decaying burst gets none
- loop_crossfade <= min(2000, start//4, length//4) (DS silently fails on large crossfades)
- Release measured per zone

**Verify:** `python3 -m pytest tests/test_postprocess.py -v`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/postprocess.py", "tests/test_postprocess.py"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -m pytest tests/test_postprocess.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["FLAC 48kHz 24-bit stereo", "sine loops cleanly", "decaying burst unlooped", "crossfade bounded", "release measured"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: DecentSampler and SFZ preset emitters
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Generate .dspreset and .sfz from metadata plus calibration.

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/emit_presets.py`, `tests/test_emit_presets.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Valid XML, one sample per zone
- Key ranges tile 0-127, velocity ranges tile 1-127, no gaps
- Reverb types 6-7 emit delay effect, 0-5 emit reverb
- Stripped LFO emits scope=voice when synced, global otherwise; RND emits none
- SFZ has one region per zone with loops and ampeg_release

**Verify:** `python3 -m pytest tests/test_emit_presets.py -v`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/emit_presets.py", "tests/test_emit_presets.py"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -m pytest tests/test_emit_presets.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["valid XML with all zones", "key ranges tile 0-127", "velocity ranges tile 1-127", "Delay types emit delay effect", "synced stripped LFO uses scope=voice", "RND emits no LFO", "sfz region per zone"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: Pilot validation gate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Render the pilot set, then confirm quality against measurable criteria and by ear before committing to the full ~5-6 hour, ~300 GB run.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/validate_pilot.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Pilot rendered: JV-880 Internal (192) and SR-JV80-04 Vintage Synth (255)
- Every patch.json has exactly 75 zones
- Every FLAC is 48000 Hz, 24-bit, stereo
- At least 25% of zones looped
- Loop discontinuity under 5% of peak on every looped zone
- Every dspreset parses; key ranges tile 0-127; all sample paths resolve
- Both reverb and delay effect types appear across the pilot
- Human check: user loads 3 presets in DecentSampler and confirms acceptable

**Verify:** `python3 tools/validate_pilot.py "/Volumes/ExtFS/charlesvestal/JV-880 Multisamples"`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/validate_pilot.py"], "verifyCommand": "python3 tools/validate_pilot.py \"/Volumes/ExtFS/charlesvestal/JV-880 Multisamples\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["all patch dirs have exactly 75 zones", "every FLAC is 48kHz 24-bit stereo", "at least 25% of zones looped", "loop discontinuity under 5% of peak", "every dspreset parses and tiles 0-127", "every sample path resolves", "both reverb and delay types appear", "user confirms 3 presets sound acceptable"], "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"], "requiresUserSpecification": false, "gateScope": "pilot libraries: JV-880 Internal and SR-JV80-04 Vintage Synth", "failurePolicy": "halt", "modelTier": "standard"}
```
